title: PR Attributes
description: Metadata describing a single PR associated with an Action Plan. A plan may carry zero or more of these in its pr_attributes[] array.

pr.description: GitHub PR number (integer preferred). Accepts a string for pre-creation drafts or branch-based identifiers where no PR number exists yet.

review_doc.description: Path to the source PR_REVIEW JSON file. Null when no formal review exists for this PR.

branch.description: Feature branch being worked on for this PR

pip_document.description: Path to the detailed implementation plan (markdown). Null when no PIP exists for this PR.

merged_at.description: Date the PR was merged (YYYY-MM-DD). Null while the PR is open.
